items.title: Risk Factors in AI Agent Token Pricing
items.claim: Pool flow and the VIRTUAL numeraire explain 90.9 percent of AI agent token daily return variance, showing mechanics dominate risk.

items.title: Generative AI in Asset Management: Too Much of a Good Thing?
items.claim: Moderate AI use raises fund returns, but intensive reliance lowers them as disclosures converge and crowding grows.
